name: How often does tile grout need to be resealed?

mainEntity.name: How often does tile grout need to be resealed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grout sealing is not a permanent treatment and typically needs reapplication every one to three years depending on room usage and exposure to moisture. High-traffic kitchen floors and daily-use shower stalls wear down protective sealers much faster than decorative backsplashes or guest bathroom walls. You can test your sealer by placing a few drops of water onto the grout line; if the water beads, the seal is working, but if it darkens the grout within a few minutes, moisture is penetrating and resealing is necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile grout typically needs resealing every 1 to 3 years. High-moisture showers require more frequent sealing than dry, low-traffic areas.
